options: Oracle's own cloud computing platform, comparable to AWS or Microsoft Azure, that Fusion Cloud runs on
A reporting tool inside Fusion Cloud Financials
An older, discontinued version of Fusion Cloud
A security role assigned to system administrators
questions.explain: OCI is Oracle's own cloud computing platform — the data centers, networking, and compute resources Fusion Cloud Applications runs on top of.

questions.q: What does a typical Oracle Fusion Cloud customer receive, at minimum?
options: Only a single environment used for everything
A Production environment and at least one non-production (test) environment
Ten identical environments regardless of company size
Access only during business hours
questions.explain: Customers get at least a Production environment for live business and at least one non-production environment for testing, as covered further in Lesson 16.

questions.q: Why can a mistake made in a non-production (test) environment never affect Production data?
options: Because test environments don't actually connect to the internet
Because only Oracle employees are allowed in test environments
Because the environments are logically separate, even though they may share the same underlying OCI infrastructure
Because test environments are deleted every night
questions.explain: Environments are logically isolated from one another even when running on shared OCI infrastructure, so changes in test don't touch production.

questions.q: What architecturally makes Oracle Fusion Cloud's unified data model possible, according to this lesson?
options: Each pillar runs on a completely different cloud vendor's infrastructure
Every customer must manually synchronize data between pillars nightly
Fusion Cloud has no actual shared architecture — it's a marketing term only
All pillars (ERP, SCM, HCM, CX, EPM) are built on one common data model and shared technology foundation, rather than being separate acquired products stitched together
questions.explain: Unlike older separate on-premises products glued together with custom interfaces, Fusion Cloud's pillars share one underlying data model and technology foundation.

questions.q: Is a Financials functional consultant expected to log into servers or configure OCI directly?
options: No — Oracle manages the infrastructure; the consultant works at the configuration and business-process level
Yes, this is a core daily responsibility
Only during the quarterly update window
Only if the company doesn't have an IT department
questions.explain: Oracle manages OCI and the underlying infrastructure; a functional consultant's work happens at the configuration and business-process layer, not server administration.
